title: JAILNEWSBENCH: MULTI-LINGUAL AND REGIONAL BENCHMARK FOR FAKE NEWS GENERATION UNDER JAILBREAK ATTACKS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the disparity in model defense capabilities (Attack Success Rate and harmfulness scores) against fake news generation across 34 different regions, highlighting higher safety performance for U.S.-related topics compared to others.

Comparing the robustness of Large Language Models to jailbreak attacks across 22 different languages and analyzing performance differences between English and non-English prompts, including the effect of translating non-English prompts into English.

Measuring the attack success rate (ASR) of prompts intentionally rewritten to induce socially biased content (as opposed to fake news) to compare the effectiveness of model safety filters against different types of harm.
